topic: Regulation for selection of site for fusing bombs and depth charge
syllabus_extract: Regulation for selection of site for fusing bombs and depth charge
specific_objectives: 28.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the need for explosive regulation

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of explosive safety zones and site selection criteria; Safety: Maintain safe distance from simulated ordnance; Supervision: Instructor monitors adherence to safety protocols
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of explosive regulations?
Why is site selection critical for bomb disposal?
Can you name one consequence of ignoring safety zones?

development.content:
Need for explosive regulation
Safety zones for fusing bombs
Safety zones for depth charges
Factors influencing site selection
Regulatory compliance requirements

Calculation of blast radius
Selection of ground type
Evacuation route planning
Communication protocols
Emergency response measures

Review of site selection checklist
Common errors in site selection
Importance of documentation
Coordination with support teams
Final verification procedures

summary_questions: Explain why specific site regulations are necessary for fusing bombs.
Describe the key factors considered when selecting a site for depth charges.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the site selection process for fusing bombs, referencing the criteria discussed in LP 02.
